ACCEPTABLE_EQUIVALENTS: a compact per-partial representation containing the information needed to combine two disjoint row portions
a hierarchical reduction whose partial records preserve the output semantics without materializing all per-element weighted vectors
an equivalent work-ownership reformulation that changes the reduction state and combines partial contributions while respecting causal prefixes
PARTIAL_PATTERNS: phase fusion with numerical validation but no changed mathematical representation
generic tiled scheduling or shared-memory staging
recomputation or launch reduction without explaining the equivalent partial computation
MISS_PATTERNS: lifetime extension or register retention as the primary mechanism
materialization removal without a replacement computation representation
generic vectorization, block-size, or warp tuning
claiming a new measured bottleneck from unknown fields
HALLUCINATION_CRITERIA: asserts kernel count, memory traffic, occupancy, or backward behavior not present in public facts
claims a numerical result or speedup as measured without evidence reference
FULL_HIT_REQUIREMENTS: observation cites the multi-stage graph and the mathematical output semantics
causal mechanism explains why the existing intermediate representation causes avoidable work or storage
concrete transformation changes the partial computation representation, reduction structure, or work ownership
semantic precondition explains why the transformed representation is mathematically equivalent, including causal-prefix handling
risk is grounded in FP16/FP32 error, register budget, scratch capacity, or backward correctness
evidence_refs point only to public facts
